scenes.title: Return to Karawa
scenes.rationale: The party closes out its exploration of the fort, inventories the recovered relics, and completes the multi-day journey back to Karawa.

scenes.title: Following Arcus's Trail
scenes.rationale: The report to Kisa flows directly into a continuous afternoon and evening investigation through Ikram and Jasu, with the immediate goal of identifying Arcus and understanding his interest in Great War artifacts.

scenes.title: The Voice among the Charmhearts
scenes.rationale: The visit to the halfling encampment introduces a new group, location, and threat when Ander reveals the consuming master's voice.

scenes.title: Shakun's Failing Protection
scenes.rationale: The attempted vigil, Candrosa's interruption, and the private temple meeting form one continuous late-night situation culminating in his revelation and plea for help.
